description: This Dart file defines a Flutter StatefulWidget for a user registration screen supporting both Nurse and Hospital roles. It includes form fields for user input, role selection via dropdown, and handles registration logic with UI updates based on registration success or failure.

classes.name: RegisterScreen
classes.description: Public registration screen widget supporting input for user details and role selection, managing registration process and navigation upon success or failure.

classes.name: _RegisterScreenState
classes.description: State class managing form state, user input, registration logic, and UI updates for RegisterScreen.

methods.name: _handlePostRegisterUi
methods.description: Handles post-registration UI updates, navigating on success or showing a failure message.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the registration screen, including form inputs, role selection, and registration button.
